# References {#references}

Sources cited in this wiki, together with the key works the three source papers
draw on. Bibliographic details follow the reference lists of those papers; where
a source gives an abbreviated form, that form is reproduced here rather than
completed by guesswork.

## The source papers {#references-sources}

**Ivimey-Cook, E. R., Culina, A., Dimri, S., Grainger, M. J., Kar, F.,
Lagisz, M., Moran, N. P., Nakagawa, S., Roche, D. G., Tattan, S.,
Sánchez-Tójar, A., Windecker, S. M., & Pick, J. L.** *TADA! Simple guidelines
to improve analytical code sharing for transparency and reproducibility.*
Companion site: <https://eivimeycook.github.io/TADA/>
Manuscript:
[`papers/ivimey-cook_etal_TADA_guidelines.pdf`](papers/ivimey-cook_etal_TADA_guidelines.pdf)

**Ivimey-Cook, E. R., Pick, J. L., Bairos-Novak, K. R., Culina, A., Gould, E.,

Sánchez-Tójar, A., Silva, I., & Windecker, S. M.** (2023). *Implementing code
review in the scientific workflow: Insights from ecology and evolutionary
biology.* Journal of Evolutionary Biology 36: 1347–1356.
<https://doi.org/10.1111/jeb.14230>
PDF:
[`papers/ivimey-cook_etal_2023_code_review.pdf`](papers/ivimey-cook_etal_2023_code_review.pdf)

**Pick, J. L., Allen, B. J., Bachelot, B., Bairos-Novak, K. R., Brand, J. A.,
Class, B., Dallas, T., D'Amelio, P. B., Fenollosa, E., Fernández-Juricic, E.,

## About this wiki {#references-about}

This wiki is a synthesis and does not present original findings. Where it
extends beyond the source papers — worked examples, comparison tables,
checklists, reviewer scripts — that material is labelled **wiki guidance**.
Corrections are welcome; see [Contribute](#contribute).

The three source PDFs are in [`papers/`](papers/README.md), with their terms of
use. The SORTEE guidelines paper is open access under CC BY 4.0.
